name: Flow_Track
description: Visual embryo flow management plugin. Displays a three-rail layout connecting egg donors, sperm donors, and surrogates with interactive nodes and connection lines. Features freezer inventory management, efficiency metrics with color-coded lifebars, date range filtering, and Excel export.
